documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Notice Of 4Th Annual General Meeting Of The Members Of OCCL Limited

analysis.summary: OCCL Limited reported financial results for Q3 and 9M FY '26, highlighting a year-on-year total income growth of 19% to INR 114.6 crores and EBITDA growth of 25% to INR 20.2 crores for the quarter. Management noted that all-time high sulphur prices have impacted margins, though anti-dumping duties and domestic automobile industry growth provide supportive conditions. Exports to the US faced tariff headwinds resulting in discounts, while domestic market share expansion remains a strategic priority despite intense competition. Management reported a Q3 FY26 revenue of approximately Rs. 115 crores and an EBITDA of Rs.

guidance.claim: The Indian tyre industry is expected to grow by 7% to 8% in FY '26.
guidance.quote: The Indian tyre industry is expected to grow by 7% to 8% in FY '26.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the India-EU Free Trade Agreement shall add comfort and support a cautiously positive medium-term export outlook.
guidance.quote: The India–EU Free Trade Agreement shall add comfort and support a cautiously positive medium-term export outlook.

guidance.claim: The trade deal with the USA is expected to lower tariffs and support better realisation in the region going forward.
guidance.quote: The recent trade deal with the USA is expected to lower tariffs and support better realsiation in the region going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Calendar year 2025 witnessed strong growth in automobile sales driven by multiple positive factors.
demand_outlook.quote: Calendar year 2025 witnessed strong growth in automobile sales driven by multiple positive factors such as reduction of GST, income tax reductions, and a more accommodative monetary policy.

demand_outlook.claim: Signs of recovery are already visible in the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: To conclude, supported by a strong financial foundation, operational agility, and long-standing customer relationships, we remain confident in our ability to emerge stronger as market conditions stabilize, with signs of recovery already visible in the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: Global capacity utilization levels for insoluble sulphur are between 70% to 75%.
demand_outlook.quote: See, the current capacity utilization levels around the world are between 70% to 75% as per our reckoning.

demand_outlook.claim: Malaysia continues to play aggressively in the Indian market with prices affected by Chinese prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Malaysia also continues to play aggressively in the Indian market. And their prices are also affected by the Chinese prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that a significant portion of exports are in Europe, where trade relations remain stable.
demand_outlook.quote: A significant portion of exports are in Europe, where trade relations remain stable.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent GST reduction on automobiles has given a boost in vehicle sales across segments.
demand_outlook.quote: The recent GST reduction on automobiles has given boost in vehicle sales across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Higher demand for cars, two-wheelers, and commercial vehicles should lead to increased tyre production, boosting demand for insoluble sulphur in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Higher demand for cars, two-wheelers, and commercial vehicles should lead to increased tyre production, which in turn will boost demand for insoluble Sulphur in India.

demand_outlook.claim: Following anti-dumping duties on imports from Japan and China, the company witnessed some improvement in domestic insoluble sulphur realisations.
demand_outlook.quote: In the domestic market, following the imposition of anti-dumping duties on imports from Japan and China, the Company has witnessed some improvement in domestic insoluble sulphur realisations.

demand_outlook.claim: The insoluble sulphur market continues to be stable.
demand_outlook.quote: The insoluble sulphur market continues to be stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Global realizations remain under pressure due to oversupply.
demand_outlook.quote: However, global realizations remain under pressure due to oversupply.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for the industry remains strong, supported by structural growth in the global tyre sector and increasing demand for high-performance environmental compliant products.
demand_outlook.quote: The long-term outlook for the industry remains strong, supported by structural growth in the global tyre sector and increasing demand for high-performance environmental compliant products.

demand_outlook.claim: While near-term realizations are expected to stay soft as supply currently exceeds demand, management remains confident in navigating short-term challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: While we expect near-term realizations to stay soft as supply currently exceeds demand, we remain confident in our ability to navigate the short-term challenges.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian tyre industry continues to demonstrate healthy momentum supported by robust demand from both OEM and replacement segments especially post-radialization.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian tyre industry continues to demonstrate healthy momentum supported by robust demand from both OEM and replacement segments especially post-radialization.

demand_outlook.claim: Approximate annual global demand increase is anticipated to be 2% to 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: We are expecting a 2% to 3% growth in demand annually.

capex_expansion.claim: Maintenance capex stood at Rs. 7 crores.
capex_expansion.quote:
Anupam Jain: This Rs.7 crore was maintenance CAPEX?
Anurag Jain: Yes.

margins_costs.claim: All-time high prices of sulphur are affecting company margins.
margins_costs.quote: Though all-time high prices of Sulphur are affecting our margins, we expect either the Sulphur prices to come down or our competition and us to pass on these increasing raw material prices to our customers.

margins_costs.claim: Average price for sulphur in Q3 was about INR 29 while the current price is about INR 52.
margins_costs.quote: You are right. The average price for Q3 was about INR29. Current price is about INR52.

margins_costs.claim: The fact that Chinese competitors did not increase prices despite higher raw material costs has taken away the benefit of anti-dumping duty.
margins_costs.quote: The fact that the Chinese did not increase the price even though raw material prices have increased, have taken away the whole benefit of the anti-dumping duty.

margins_costs.claim: The annual impact of the anti-dumping duty estimated earlier was in the range of INR 11 to 14 crores per annum.
margins_costs.quote: See, the impact -- annual impact of the duty that we had estimated earlier was in the range of INR12 to 14 crores or INR11-INR14 crores per annum.

margins_costs.claim: During Q3 FY26, revenue stood at approximately Rs. 115 crores while EBITDA grew by 26% to Rs. 20 crores with an EBITDA margin of 17.6%.
margins_costs.quote: During Q3 FY26, Revenue stood at ~Rs. 115 crores, while EBITDA grew by 26% Rs. 20 crores with an EBITDA margin of 17.6%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the period grew by 24% to Rs. 6.5 crores.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the period grew by 24% to Rs. 6.5 crores.

margins_costs.claim: High sulphur prices which impact margin remain a challenge.
margins_costs.quote: Though high sulphur prices which impacts margin remain a challenge.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs. 121 crores, EBITDA at Rs. 20 crores with EBITDA margins at 16.8%, and profit after tax at Rs. 9 crores with PAT margins at 7.2%.
margins_costs.quote: Total income for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs.121 crores, compared to Rs.104 crores in Q2 FY25, a growth of 16%. EBITDA for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs.20 crores, against Rs.19 crores in Q2 FY25, a 5% year-on-year growth. The EBITDA margins were 16.8%. Profit after tax for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs.9 crores as compared to Rs.8 crores in Q2 FY25, a 16% growth year-on-year. PAT margins stood at 7.2%.

margins_costs.claim: Over the past few months, benchmark sulphur costs have seen a steady uptrend, driven by tight supply and stronger demand.
margins_costs.quote: Over the past few months, benchmark sulphur costs have seen a steady uptrend, driven by tight supply and stronger demand, putting pressure on input costs across the industry.

margins_costs.claim: On insoluble sulphur, the increase merely on account of the cost of sulphur for the quarter ended September 2025 versus September 2024 is more than Rs. 10,000 per tonne.
margins_costs.quote: If you look at the increase in cost of sulphur, on insoluble sulphur, the increase merely on account of cost of sulphur for quarter ended September 2025 versus quarter ended September 2024 is more than Rs. 10,000 per tonne.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity utilization is around 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: So the capacity utilization is around 70%.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volumes and next quarter's volume expectations remain stable without significant increases.
orders_capacity.quote: See, the volumes have been stable. We have neither increased the volume and the next quarter also we are not looking at any significant increase in volumes.

orders_capacity.claim: Current annual capacity of insoluble sulphur is 17,500 MT at Dharuhera and 22,000 MT at SEZ Mundra.
orders_capacity.quote:
Insoluble Sulphur 17,500 Dharuhera (Haryana) 3
Insoluble Sulphur 22,000 SEZ Mundra (Gujarat) 4

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for insoluble sulphur is roughly 70% and sulphuric acid is at full capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Insoluble sulphur is roughly 70% and sulphuric acid is full capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Total supply of insoluble sulphur after expansion of players is 3,57,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote:
Kunal Ochiramani: What I understand post expansion of some of the players including you, total supply is 3,57,000 tons. And what should be the approximate demand?
Anurag Jain: Approximate demand should be somewhere around 2.75 lakh to 3 lakh tons.

capital_allocation.claim: There are currently no plans for a share buyback as of now.
capital_allocation.quote: No, there are currently no plans for share buyback as of now.

capital_allocation.claim: The long-term debt of the company stands at INR 22.75 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: See, the long-term debt as of now is INR22.75 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital credit facility is in the range of between INR 30 and INR 40 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Range of between INR30 and INR40 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt position as on September 2025 stood at Rs. 81 crores, with long-term debt of Rs. 26.5 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Total debt position as on September 2025 stood at Rs.81 crores, with long-term debt of Rs.26.5 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global oversupply and weak pricing internationally create a supply glut where supply exceeds demand.
Exports to the US remained subject to a 50% tariff at the time of the call.
risks_headwinds.quote: One second, Anurag, what is going out right now, my understanding is it's still subject to 50% tariff.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged high sulphur prices as a challenge that impacts margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though high sulphur prices which impacts margin remain a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: The United States imposed a 50% tariff on imports from India, impacting margins to the extent of the quantity supplied there.
risks_headwinds.quote: The recent move by the United States to impose a 50% tariff on imports from India has also impacted our margins to the effect of the quantity that we are supplying there.

risks_headwinds.claim: Earlier the effective US tariff rate was zero, and now it is 50%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Anurag Jain: Earlier the effective tariff rate was zero, now it is 50%.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to aggressively look at increasing its share in the domestic market in the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So we are aggressively looking at increasing our share in the domestic market, and that strategy is going to get more focused in the coming year.

management_commitments.claim: Management is hopeful that the US tariff situation should get resolved soon.
management_commitments.quote: Though we are hopeful that this whole tariff situation should get resolved soon.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects that once the tariff situation is sorted out, margins should also come back.
management_commitments.quote: and once this whole tariff thing is sorted out, then our margins should also come back.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
